question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The context of the sentence **requires a noun that indicates a mixture or joining of elements.** • The word **"combination" fits well as it denotes a joining or merging of different elements.** • "**Combination**" aligns with the context as it suggests a union of parts, which is appropriate for the given scenario. • Other options ("**association**", "**collaboration**", "**cooperation**") do not fit as precisely within the context. • The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 5 is **'combination.'***.* Therefore the correct statement from the passage is ***"******They are made up of a combination __of hydrocarbons."*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Association (संगठन): "Association" **refers to a group of people organized for a joint purpose, which does not fit the context of discussing forest fire hazards. • **Collaboration (सहयोग): "Collaboration" **means working together to achieve a common goal, which does not reflect the idea of a mixture or joining. • **Cooperation (सहयोग): "Cooperation" **means working together towards a common end, which does not align with the idea of a combination of elements. 47:Tf5d,
